segments.title: 第58章 操場K歌
segments.content:
After dinner, it was time for the evening military training session.

As they were preparing to leave the classroom, Lin Yuan eagerly sidled up to Li Luo, staring intently at the guitar case.

"Here, you can carry it," Li Luo said, handing the guitar case to him. "You can play it first tonight."

"Alright!" Lin Yuan rubbed his hands together, took the case with a grin, and slung it on his back like a treasure, willingly acting as Li Luo's porter.

The group went downstairs and gathered on the sports field. The guitar case was placed under the shade of a tree, leaning against the trunk.

When the military training began, Li Luo was called away for a meeting again, receiving further instructions from the dean of students about the bus trip to the military camp the next afternoon.

"Are you going to play the guitar when you get back?" Ying Chanxi turned and asked as they walked downstairs after the meeting.

"I guess so, why?"

"I want to listen too."

"You want to transfer to Class 8? I'm afraid I'd be beaten to death by Teacher Sun," Li Luo said with a laugh. "But if you really want to listen, remember to prick up your ears in a bit."

"Huh? What do you mean?" Ying Chanxi looked at Li Luo with some curiosity, but seeing him just smile without saying anything, she huffed. Having no idea what trick he was playing, she could only kick at the grass and walk toward Class 1.

Halfway there, Ying Chanxi couldn't help but turn back. From a distance, she saw Li Luo take the guitar from beside the tree and hand it to a classmate.

She felt a bit like watching, but she still returned to Class 1 and sat down next to Qiao Xinyan.

"Hey, Xixi, look." Qiao Xinyan poked Ying Chanxi's waist and gestured forward with her chin. "Xie Shuchen borrowed a guitar from somewhere and says he's going to perform. He wouldn't play all this time, but as soon as you came back, he went up there, haha~"

Xie Shuchen was a boy who could rank in the top ten in Class 1. He had also learned the piano and earned a level-ten certificate, and he knew a little about the guitar. With his handsome looks and well-styled hair, some of the first-year girls paid quite a bit of attention to him.

But like many other boys, as soon as the school year started, Xie Shuchen's gaze was completely captured by Ying Chanxi.

However, he wasn't as obvious about it as Liu Shaowen. Based on his glorious track record and experience from middle school, a girl like Ying Chanxi couldn't be pursued with a direct approach.

He had to first display his own charm, attract her attention, and then occasionally reveal how special she was to him, gradually letting her sink into this exclusive treatment.

With some push and pull in between, playing on a young girl's sensitivity, vanity, and competitiveness, she would soon become completely immersed in her adoration for him.

As Xie Shuchen thought this, he was already holding the guitar and walking to the front. He strummed the strings before everyone, looking quite stylish.

"A song for you all, 'Those Flowers'."

Xie Shuchen struck a pose he thought was cool. The corner of his eye glanced at Ying Chanxi, and seeing that she was looking at him, he curled his lips in satisfaction and immersed himself in his own singing.

But as Ying Chanxi looked at Xie Shuchen, she imagined Li Luo standing up there. When she saw Xie Shuchen's face clearly, she sighed helplessly and turned her head again to look toward Class 8.

He told her to prick up her ears and listen, but from this far away, what could she possibly hear?

...

Meanwhile, in Class 8, Lin Yuan had borrowed Li Luo's guitar and was just about to start singing.

But then he saw Li Luo make a pressing-down motion with his palm and point toward the entrance of the sports field.

Lin Yuan turned his head with a puzzled look and saw Teacher Kong walking over. He immediately tensed up, feeling a bit too shy to sing.

"Why is Teacher Kong here?" Lin Yuan asked, a little embarrassed.

"Oh, he's bringing the sound system," Li Luo smiled and waved at Kong Junxiang in the distance. "Wait until the speaker is here before you sing, it'll be more satisfying that way."

"What? A sound system?" Lin Yuan looked completely baffled.

Only when Kong Junxiang got closer did he realize that Teacher Kong was carrying a black speaker and two microphones.

"Here, I borrowed this from the school for you." Kong Junxiang placed the speaker on the ground and handed the microphones to Li Luo. "This is from the music room. Leave it in our classroom for tonight, and you can return it tomorrow morning."

"Alright, thank you, Teacher Kong." After thanking him, Li Luo knelt down and fiddled with it for a bit. Confirming there were no issues, he set up one microphone in front of the guitar and handed the other one to Lin Yuan.

In the afternoon, Li Luo had been called to the office by Kong Junxiang for some matter, so he had taken the opportunity to ask if the school had a sound system that could be used directly on the sports field.

Normally, Kong Junxiang would never have gone out of his way to get a sound system for a student to sing.

But Li Luo's performance over the past two days had left him very satisfied, so he simply nodded and agreed, telling him to wait for it in the evening.

In the end, he delivered on his promise, getting Li Luo a speaker to play with.

"Sing. Why are you just standing there?" After setting up the sound system, Li Luo saw Lin Yuan frozen in place with an anxious expression.

"Class monitor, are we really singing?" Lin Yuan was a bit embarrassed.

Singing in front of the whole class was already his limit.

Now with a sound system, students all over the sports field would be able to hear. The thought of that scene made his legs feel numb, and he couldn't help but shrink back.

"There's a first time for everything. Practice more, and you'll get used to it," Li Luo walked closer to Lin Yuan, took the microphone, and then spoke into it. "Good evening, everyone. This is Li Luo from Class 8."

"Next up, our classmate Lin Yuan will present everyone with a song..."

"...a song called what again?" Li Luo looked at Lin Yuan with a questioning expression.

"Ye, ye, ye..."

"What are you 'yeah'-ing about?"

"I mean... 'Brightest Star in the Night Sky'!"

Waves of laughter rippled across the sports field, and some people cheered and clapped. The atmosphere instantly became lively.

"Alright! 'Brightest Star in the Night Sky'!" Li Luo positioned the microphone stand in front of Lin Yuan and gave him an encouraging look. "Presented by our classmate Lin Yuan."

Having been pushed into the spotlight like this, Lin Yuan took a slow breath, forcing himself to calm down. He then lowered his head and began to strum the guitar strings.

He didn't get into the zone right away, playing the intro repeatedly until he was completely immersed in the music.

"Brightest star in the night sky~"

"Can you hear~"

"The one who looks up~"

"The loneliness and sighs in their heart~"

Far away in Class 1, Xie Shuchen stood at the front holding his guitar. He was just getting to the climax of his song when he was abruptly interrupted by the sound from over there.

He now wore a speechless and awkward expression, thinking, *Isn't this unsportsmanlike?*... The other side brought out a sound system, how could his own voice possibly compete?

Meanwhile, over at Class 8.

Li Luo returned to his seat next to Yan Zhusheng and nodded with satisfaction.

Beside him, Yan Zhusheng said, "He sang two notes wrong again."

"You should be a little more tolerant of our classmates," Li Luo said helplessly. "If I sing off-key later, don't say that to me, okay?"

"Okay," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "I'll wait until after you finish singing to say it."

"Don't say it even after I'm finished."

When Lin Yuan finished his song, he felt his back break out in sweat again. His whole body was trembling, yet he also felt a sense of exhilarating release.

Fierce applause erupted from the sports field.

Although there were many flaws in his performance, everyone was caught up in the atmosphere, cheering and clapping for Lin Yuan.

"Thank you, everyone." Seeing the reaction of the surrounding classmates, Lin Yuan's face flushed with excitement. But after coming out of his state of immersion, his fingers were trembling so much that he couldn't play the guitar anymore, so he quickly said, "Next up, our Class 8's monitor, Li Luo, will sing a song for everyone!"

In the Class 1 formation, Ying Chanxi heard what Lin Yuan said and immediately turned to look in Class 8's direction. A light flashed in her eyes, and her heart filled with anticipation.

Beside her, Qiao Xinyan also shook Ying Chanxi's shoulder. "Li Luo is up, he's up, he's up! Xixi, look!"

"Why are you so excited?" Ying Chanxi looked at Qiao Xinyan with suspicion.

"He's your cousin," Qiao Xinyan said, stunned for a moment, not understanding what Ying Chanxi meant.

Seeing that she really didn't have any other ideas, Ying Chanxi guiltily averted her gaze. "Oh, it's nothing. Let's listen to the song."

Li Luo was seen standing up from the crowd, striding forward to take the guitar and microphone, and walking over to the speaker.

"A song for everyone, 'The Ordinary Road'."

"I wish for all of us to be content with being ordinary, and yet to be great and shine within that ordinariness."
